subject: Fwd: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)
body:
From: FinOps <finops@windward.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 8:04 AM
Subject: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)

Hi Kimberly,

We are seeing a token accounting discrepancy between the console usage totals and the token counts we derive from our application logs for streaming. Can you confirm which number is authoritative for billing?

Thanks,
— Windward FinOps


---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: FinOps <finops@windward.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 10:22 AM
Subject: Re: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)

Thanks — the invoice export and console usage pull from the same billing meter. In past cases, the 'token accounting discrepancy' comes from streaming retries/reconnects or counting only the final chunk on the client side.

Can you share whether you are using idempotency keys and what your retry policy is on disconnect?

Best,
Kimberly


---
From: FinOps <finops@windward.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 12:01 PM
Subject: Re: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)

We retry on 499/timeout and do not currently set idempotency keys.


---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: FinOps <finops@windward.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 1:40 PM
Subject: Re: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)

Looping in Support Ops. We'll open a ticket so Eng can confirm the exact behavior. In the meantime, please try adding an idempotency-key header on retries to avoid duplicate work.


---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, FinOps <finops@windward.ai>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 4:18 PM
Subject: Re: Question about token accounting discrepancy (Feb invoice vs usage)

Confirmed: billing is per token emitted; if a stream reconnect results in tokens being emitted again, those will be billed. This usually resolves the 'token accounting discrepancy' customers see when they reconcile against application logs.

If you want, we can send a short written explanation for your finance team.
